user.title: Dune HD
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Dune HD player (see Setup > Information). Port is 80, or 11080 for Google-certified ATV models.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the player. Check the IP address, port and that the player is on the network.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like a Dune HD IP Control endpoint.

open_path.name: Open path
open_path.description: Open a folder, menu section or item in the player GUI (protocol 4+).

black_screen.name: Black screen
black_screen.description: Stop playback and switch the player to black screen state.
